key_points: Nvidia leadership turmoil may trigger short‑term AI stock sell‑off, pressuring memory demand.
Micron beat earnings, has strong cash flow and high‑bandwidth memory sales, supporting fundamentals.
Recent price rebound of ~13% and undervaluation estimates (≈42% undervalued) indicate upside potential.
Mixed analyst sentiment: bullish on cash flow and growth, bearish on 40% peak decline and AI volatility.
Overall AI hardware sentiment remains volatile, likely keeping Micron’s price range‑bound in the coming weeks.
